'''Dorran Kaith''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[third Galactic War]] on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="Vaiken" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dorran Kaith appears in the [[May]] [[2024]] Game Update 7.5 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', on Vaiken Spacedock. Kaith is not a vendor and not part of any missions and therefore can't be interacted with.<ref name="Vaiken" />
